limitations: Five large model/tokenizer files were inventoried on Drive but not downloaded or hash-verified here.
The local result folder is an analysis copy, not a complete inference package.
Qwen NF4 checkpoint inference was not independently rerun locally; the saved Colab 16-sample reload check passed.
Historical baselines are saved CSV comparisons, not new checkpoint inference runs.
Official Validation has been inspected repeatedly; bootstrap intervals are conditional on fixed saved predictions and do not include training-seed or selection uncertainty.
Pilot development/confirmation and final official Validation use different examples; their score differences do not isolate the effect of more training data.
One selected epoch and one seed do not establish convergence or a reliable gain from more epochs.
